question: Should first-party Control UI math rendering be accepted in core, and if so what delimiter behavior and dependency/vendor provenance are required before merge?
rationale: The feature is useful, but accepting global math rendering changes existing text semantics and adds same-origin third-party UI code, so automation should not choose the permanent product/security boundary.

options.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
options.body: Require a package/build or approved vendoring path and remove single-dollar inline parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.

options.title: Accept documented vendoring
options.body: Allow a vendored MathJax asset only after source, version, license, update process, and review ownership are documented.

options.title: Defer core math rendering
options.body: Pause or close candidate PRs until the canonical feature request has a sponsored design for core versus extension ownership.

recommendation.title: Track dependency and narrow parsing
recommendation.body: Require a package/build or approved vendoring path and remove single-dollar inline parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.
